server.name: Agentic Atlas
server.title: Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns
server.description: Helps an agent design or review an agent system: find the patterns, concepts, examples, decisions, and terms that fit its problem, read their guidance, and follow how they relate, all from one published Agentic Atlas Release through read-only tools.

live.instructions: Consult one active Agentic Atlas Release. Every tool addresses its payload directly: call atlas_cards with the canonical ids you already know, atlas_read for any exact canonical address, and atlas_orient only when you do not yet have an identity. atlas_orient ranks whole-word matches (a word of four or more characters also matches longer words it begins), each word weighed by how few subjects carry it in an identity field: a match in an identity field or a Card claim makes a subject a candidate, a match in Section text makes one only when no subject matches an identity field, and total counts the candidates. A complete Node from atlas_read is prose alone; its relationships come from atlas_links. Carry the coherence marker each payload returns as expected_revision on every later call, so a promotion is refused rather than silently crossed. Use atlas_navigate for the canonical tree or the publisher-curated tour. Every payload's scope.omitted_fact_classes names what it withheld; each class has one fixed recovery: claims via atlas_cards, sections via atlas_read, and links via atlas_links, each addressed at the subject in hand; provenance via atlas_cards with the subject id and provenance=true; decisions via atlas_orient with query='' and kind='decision', then a single decision via atlas_read at the returned 'decision:<decision-id>' address; terms via atlas_orient with kind='term', then optionally atlas_read at the returned 'term:<key>' address. A definition read names that term: subject and declares no omitted fact classes. A truncated collection returns scope.next_cursor; continue it by repeating the same call with cursor.

annotations.title: Search Atlas Nodes, Decisions, and Terms

tools.description: Find Atlas entries by topic when you hold no id; an id you already hold can be read directly. Searches Nodes (patterns, concepts, examples) and Roadmap entries (announced, unpublished); kind narrows it to one Node kind, Decisions, or glossary terms. Ids, titles, Hooks (one-line summaries), and claims decide candidacy, Section text only when no subject matches those; order is identity score, then Section score, then how many words matched, then the publisher's order. Returns ranked ids with Hooks (a term's is its whole definition), paged with a cursor. A miss is an empty page; invalid arguments are refused as invalid_argument.

examples: keep bulky context out of the window

query.description: A topic or question in ordinary design vocabulary. Words match whole words (four or more characters also match longer words they begin; stopwords drop) in canonical ids, titles, Hooks, and claims, then Section headings and bodies; rarer words weigh more. Section text makes a candidate only when no subject matches elsewhere, so total counts the candidates. kind='decision' searches Decision ids, titles, and bodies; kind='term', keys and definitions. Empty lists every subject of the kind.

kind.description: Narrows the search to one Node kind, to Decision records, or to glossary terms. Omit it to search every Node kind plus Roadmap entries (announced, unpublished); setting it leaves Roadmap entries out.

status.description: Maturity filter. Published Nodes are 'fleshed' or 'stable'; Roadmap entries may be any rung. Refused with kind 'decision' or 'term'.

bound.description: How many ranked candidates this call returns; raise it to compare more matches at once, and continue past it with cursor.

cursor.description: scope.next_cursor from a prior atlas_orient page; repeat the same other arguments.

expected_revision.description: Pins this call to the Release (published edition) a prior payload named in 'coherence'; refused as 'revision_changed' if the active Release has changed. Omit for the active Release.

tools.name: atlas_orient

data.description: candidates, ranked. A Node candidate has id, status, hook, and disclosure ('full', or 'roadmap' with its title); a Decision or term candidate has id, which is its atlas_read address, and hook.

tools.title: Search Atlas Nodes, Decisions, and Terms

annotations.title: Get Atlas Summary Cards by ID

tools.description: Get one summary Card per Atlas Node id: its Hook (one-line summary) and the publisher's claims (thesis, law, when-to-reach, or claim), each citing its source Sections. Use when you hold ids and want their guidance without full text, such as to compare entries. Cards return in request order. Atomic: one unknown or Roadmap-only (unpublished) id refuses the whole batch as batch_not_atomic, naming the rejected ids.

ids.description: The Nodes to summarize, as bare ids (no '#section') such as atlas_orient candidate ids or atlas_navigate tree ids; Cards return in this order.

provenance.description: true also returns each cited source's content digest and publisher attestation (who, when), plus the Release's digests: a larger response.

expected_revision.description: Pins this call to the Release (published edition) a prior payload named in 'coherence'; refused as 'revision_changed' if the active Release has changed. Omit for the active Release.

tools.name: atlas_cards

data.description: cards, one per requested id in request order: id, title, kind, status, hook, and claims (id, text, field, sources as 'node-id#section-slug'). With provenance=true, also provenance: release (version and digests) and addresses, each with address, dependency_digest, distillation, and attestation (publisher, attested_on).

tools.title: Get Atlas Summary Cards by ID

annotations.title: Read an Atlas Node, Section, Decision, or Term

tools.description: Read the full text at one exact Atlas address. A bare Node id returns the whole entry: identity, tree position, Hook (one-line summary), and every Section; relationship occurrences are omitted. A Section, Decision, or glossary term address returns that one item. Use when a summary is not enough or you need exact wording to cite. An unknown or malformed address is refused as invalid_argument; a wrong slug's refusal lists the real ones.

address.description: A bare Node id, 'node-id#section-slug', 'decision:<decision-id>', or 'term:<key>'. Slugs are not guessable: read them off a Node's sections, a Card claim's sources, or a Link's occurrence.

expected_revision.description: Pins this call to the Release (published edition) a prior payload named in 'coherence'; refused as 'revision_changed' if the active Release has changed. Omit for the active Release.

tools.name: atlas_read

data.description: node: identity (id, title, kind, status), hierarchy (parent, ancestors, breadcrumb, sibling_position, sibling_count), hook, and sections (slug, heading, position, content). section: section. decision: decision (id, title, content). definition: term and definition.

tools.title: Read an Atlas Node, Section, Decision, or Term

tools.description: List where one Atlas Node references other entries (outbound) and where they reference it (inbound), outbound first. Use to find related entries or what points at this one. Each occurrence gives direction, class, source Section, and the far end's Hook (one-line summary), plus its id and title unless the class is 'undisclosed' (unpublished and unannounced). Results are paged: follow the cursor to the end before concluding nothing points here. An unknown or Roadmap-only (unpublished) subject is refused as invalid_argument.

subject.description: A bare Node id (no '#section'), e.g. an atlas_orient candidate id or a Card id.

bound.description: How many relationship occurrences this call returns; continue with cursor until the page is no longer truncated.

cursor.description: scope.next_cursor from a prior atlas_links page; repeat the same other arguments.

expected_revision.description: Pins this call to the Release (published edition) a prior payload named in 'coherence'; refused as 'revision_changed' if the active Release has changed. Omit for the active Release.

tools.name: atlas_links

data.description: links: per occurrence, class ('in-slice', 'roadmap-disclosed', 'undisclosed'), direction, occurrence (section slug, ordinal), the far end's target id and title unless undisclosed, and its hook.

tools.title: List an Atlas Node's Relationships

annotations.title: Browse the Atlas Tree or Guided Tour

tools.description: Browse the whole Atlas in the publisher's order: the canonical tree of every published Node, or the guided first learning path, an introduction then steps each naming a Node id with narration. Use to survey what exists or to start learning with no topic in mind. Neither view carries entry text or claims; the tour is null if none is published.

view.description: Choose tree to survey every published Node in canonical order, or tour to follow the publisher's guided first learning path.

expected_revision.description: Pins this call to the Release (published edition) a prior payload named in 'coherence'; refused as 'revision_changed' if the active Release has changed. Omit for the active Release.

tools.name: atlas_navigate

data.description: tree: tree entries (id, title, position, depth). tour: path (id, title, intro, steps of position, node id, narration), or null when the Release seals no tour.

tools.title: Browse the Atlas Tree or Guided Tour
